note: L4 districts (MAP_REDESIGN.md): one polygon set, no gaps or overlaps on land; metres, x east, y north. Authored from the approved sketch (D-106); the game still reads MapCity's ten rectangles until L4 lands. The southern districts run to the sea (y -13 km) so the real coast, further south than the sketch drew it, has no gaps.

districts.name: San Telmo Centro
districts.note: Downtown: the club, the twelve businesses, the Living District. Bounds as today.

districts.name: Barrio Chino
districts.note: Residential, the lock-up stash. Stretched to the waterfront so there is no gap.

districts.name: The Docks
districts.note: The port and Warehouse 7. The harbour basin sits between it and the customs house.

districts.name: Airport Coast
districts.note: HAR and the plain into town.

districts.name: Rio Negro Estuary
districts.note: Mangroves, swamp, the sand-bar strip and the shack.

districts.name: Valle Verde
districts.note: New town (D-46): about 4 × 3 km of streets around the regional strip, the plain's market town. Split out of today's 18 km Valle Verde rectangle.

districts.name: The Farm Plain
districts.note: The rest of today's Valle Verde, renamed: fields, hedgerows, Finca Morales.

districts.name: Costa Este
districts.note: New: the coast road east of town, beaches and holiday villas. Today this land falls in no district.

districts.name: Sierra del Aguila
districts.note: The highland: the mesa strip and the hillside villa.

districts.name: La Selva
districts.note: The jungle range. Takes the north-east corner nobody had.

districts.name: Old Quarry
districts.note: Dry scrub hills, the quarry and its shed; the east road's chokepoint.

districts.name: Smuggler's Cove
districts.note: The cove lowland and its beach strip.

districts.name: Cayo Largo
districts.note: New as a district of its own: the cays offshore with their strip and the boathouse. Today they sit inside the cove's rectangle.
